title: Decant: Color Sort Puzzle
summary: Pour a little color. Make a little order. Decant is a color-sort puzzle with luminous glass vessels and a simple goal: leave each filled vessel with just one color. Tap a vessel, choose a matching color or an empty space, and pour the top group. Two spare vessels give you room to think—not a shortcut to buy. NO ADS. ROOM TO PLAY. - 180 puzzles across four difficulty levels, each checked for a solution. - A fresh, always-free Daily, with the same ranked board and rules for everyone. - Practice puzzles generated and checked before you play. - Satisfying glass pours—or instant pours when you prefer to skip the animation. - Liquid symbols, a high-contrast palette, and sound, haptic, handedness, and motion controls. - Free restarts. No lives, energy, timers, or extra vessels for sale. Find a solution, then try to make it cleaner. A Perfect clear uses the fewest possible pours. Older archived Daily puzzles may show a Target instead; that is a reference solution, not a promise of the minimum. START FREE. UNLOCK MORE IF YOU LIKE. The first 30 puzzles, today's Daily, and three practice puzzles per day are free, with three undos per board. The Daily does not count against your practice allowance. A one-time Decant Full Game Unlock opens all 180 puzzles, unlimited practice and undos outside the ranked Daily, the full Daily archive for unranked practice, and advanced records. Or choose the StackForge Play Pass for Pro access across StackForge games and One Good Thing. Prices are shown before purchase. Play Pass subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Today's ranked Daily gives every player the same three undos, whether free or Pro. No ads in either tier. Optional account sync keeps your progress and Play Pass connected. title: Tindrift: Merge Roguelike
summary: One slide moves your whole army. Tindrift is a tactics roguelike built on slide-merge combat: same-class, same-rank soldiers merge into a higher rank, and every shadow acts by rule — no dice, ever. 100 floors across five acts, plus an Endless Drift, a Daily Seed and 1v1 duels. The campaign plays offline. NO LUCK TO BLAME Shadows telegraph the move they are about to make, gates cycle on a visible clock, and pits sit where you can plan around them. When a run ends you can name the exact slide that ended it — and when you win, you out-thought the board. YOU COMMAND AN ARMY, NOT A HERO Six soldier classes — vanguard, tank, medic, marksman, poisoner, support — merge only with their own kind, so every squad trades coverage against raw power. Set the formation before you climb: tank into the crowd, marksman down the long lane, medic in the middle. WHAT IS IN THE GAME • A 5-act campaign across 100 floors — 20 per act, with 3 mini-boss fights and one signature boss in each • The Sunken Tray, The Rusthold, The Shivering Span, The Frostlight, The Surface: five acts, one climb, ending in daylight • 46 synergy blueprints (15 common, 23 uncommon, 8 rare) — pierce a lane, detonate poison chains, strip terrain for scrap, or take a drawback for reach • 24 shadow archetypes, 5 mini-bosses and 5 act bosses among them, each with a rule you have to read before you can answer it • 8 terrain types — sealed exits, timed gates, pits, fog and mazes: the map fights back • 7 kinds of tactic across 8 placeable tools, plus a TINKER STATION between floors to heal, promote, recruit and re-arm • An 18-node cog tree worth 2,335 cog — side-grades and finishes, never raw stats • 22 achievements and 3 daily quests drawn from 7 types • Endless Drift, and a Daily Seed with streaks and a result you can share • 1v1 duels, same seed and separate boards: three bot difficulties offline, or trade a 6-character code with a friend, send sabotage between floors and replay their round • Four languages: English, Turkish, German and Spanish • VoiceOver reads the board and re-announces it after every slide, and hazards are named instead of signalled by colour alone VARIETY UNLOCKS, POWER DOES NOT Nothing here is pay-to-win. Loadouts, tactics and blueprints stay behind cog for every player, and the limits per run are the same for everyone: one continue, two rerolls, three undos. ADS, PLAINLY Rewarded videos are always your choice — five spots, all opt-in. Full-screen breaks land on floor transitions and after a run, at most one every two minutes, never mid-move and never on the way into a boss or mini-boss floor. Duels carry none. TINDRIFT PREMIUM — one purchase, no subscription • Removes every ad • Lets you HOST duel rooms (joining a room is always free) • Unlocks the 10 cosmetics the workshop sells: 8 soldier finishes and 2 tray themes Slide. Merge. Climb.

title: Astonischika
summary: Astonischika is a turn-based pixel role-playing game with a roguelite loop. Build a party from bold classes, climb a branching map and fight turn by turn against monsters, elites and bosses. Every run is different: you choose your path across battles, rest sites, treasure, merchants and minigames. When your party falls, the city remains your permanent home — your heroes, their gold and their gear grow from run to run. FEATURES • Build your party from a range of classes — warrior, mage, cleric, rogue, archer and more • Turn-based battles with skills, spells, elements and status effects • Branching map: battle, elite, boss, rest, treasure and merchant • Level-ups, attribute points, equipment and learnable spells • Minigames: shell game, dice, memory, coin flip and more • A permanent city hub — your progress stays after every run • Endless scaling for long-term motivation • 22 languages, music and sound effects GREAT FOR Quick battle rounds in between, or long dungeon sessions.

Top Features: • Search schedules and book bus trips for yourself, friends, or family • Track your bus in real time with live updates • Rebook or cancel trips with just a few taps • Access mobile tickets instantly for easy boarding • Select your seat and pay for extra baggage • Compare coach class amenities to pick your ride style • Save with promo codes and travel discounts • Join the Red Rider Loyalty Program and earn free trips • Manage your profile, trips, payments, and travel preferences • Reach out to customer support RedCoach puts smarter travel at your fingertips, delivering comfort, convenience, and complete control.

title: DelveKin: Dungeon Defense
summary: The heroes are coming. Build a dungeon worthy of stopping them! DelveKin is a charming dungeon defense strategy game where you take the role of the Dungeon Master. Design your defenses, place traps, command monsters, and battle invading heroes across handcrafted encounters and replay-able dungeon challenges. BUILD YOUR DUNGEON - Choose rooms with different layouts and tactical advantages, then fill them with monsters and traps. Every placement matters as heroes advance deeper into your dungeon. COMMAND YOUR MONSTERS - Take direct control during turn-based battles. Move across the battlefield, launch basic attacks, unleash special abilities, and combine your monsters' strengths to overcome each group of heroes. SET CLEVER TRAPS - Slow heroes with snares, strike from the walls with arrow slits, or punish careless movement with hidden hazards. Traps can shape the battlefield and create opportunities for your monsters. GROW YOUR ARSENAL - Unlock new monsters, traps, rooms, and powerful bosses as you progress. Earn experience, level up your defenses, and build stronger dungeon teams for the challenges ahead. FACE NEW HEROES - Each stage introduces different hero combinations, abilities, and tactical threats. Adapt your dungeon to withstand knights, mages, rogues, clerics, and other determined adventurers. VENTURE INTO DEEP DELVE - Put your dungeon building skills to the ultimate test in Deep Delve, a replay-able 20-depth challenge where every run is different. Build a run specific roster, recruit and replace monsters and traps, choose powerful upgrades, evolve your boss, and see how deep your dungeon can survive. CONTINUE INTO DUNGEON RAIDS - Complete the main campaign and enter Dungeon Raids, where increasingly dangerous hero parties push your defenses even further. CHARMING ART STYLE - DelveKin features expressive characters, lively battle animations, and a playful fantasy world. Play the opening chapters for free. A single Premium unlock opens the full campaign, additional progression, Dungeon Raids, and Deep Delve. Build carefully. Fight cleverly. Protect your dungeon.

title: Word Tack
summary: Sort scattered words into their hidden groups in Word Tack, a cozy word puzzle with a handmade feel: washi tape, typewriter labels and paper tiles that look cut out by hand. Every puzzle hides eight groups of five words. Drag tiles between rows, or tap two tiles to swap them. When a row holds all five words of a group, it’s sealed and its category is revealed. There’s no timer and no penalty for a wrong guess, so take your time. PLAY YOUR WAY • A growing campaign of handcrafted levels, from everyday categories to clever wordplay and real head-scratchers, with more added in updates • Every level is marked easy, medium or hard • A Daily Puzzle to play each day, with shareable emoji results and a streak to keep GENTLE HELP WHEN YOU’RE STUCK • Inklings link two words from the same group • Clues reveal the names of up to three groups • Solve a puzzle without help to earn all three stars MAKE THE DESK YOUR OWN • Earn stamps as you play • Spend them in the shop on washi tape, tile styles, row seals, desk backgrounds and confetti, including dazzling gold and holographic finishes MADE WITH CARE • Satisfying sounds, gentle haptics and a soft soundtrack, each with its own setting • Statistics, star ratings and daily streaks to track your progress • Works with VoiceOver: double-tap two cards to swap them, and hear when rows are solved and where each card sits on the board • A Reduce Motion setting for calmer play • No ads, no in-app purchases and no account needed. Works offline.

title: ArcFlush: Roguelike Solitaire
summary: Cards don't line up politely here. They're stacked in layers — the way mahjong tiles are stacked, except these are playing cards, and one of the maps is on fire. Which means there are two games sitting on top of each other: getting a card out of the pile, and knowing what to do with it once you have it. HOW IT WORKS · The map is a layered formation. Anything underneath is locked until you clear what's covering it, so every card you take decides what you're allowed to take next. That half is solitaire. · Play up to five of the cards you've taken as a poker hand. A pair is fine. A Flush is better. A Straight Flush means you planned ahead — or got lucky and will claim you planned ahead. That half is poker. · Beat the stage's target score, spend what you earned in the Shop, and do it again. And again. Until the target has grown a couple of digits and you're no longer certain which of your trinkets is doing the heavy lifting. WHAT'S IN IT · Every map is built around exactly one idea. Ice Lake freezes cards. Furnace sets them alight. Dark Pool turns the lights off and invites you to feel your way out. · Clear a map and its Twist unlocks: the same map, in a considerably worse mood. · Trinkets. Some add points. Some quietly rewrite a rule you'd assumed was permanent. The legendary ones turn up rarely enough that finding the right one feels like the run has decided to help you, just this once. · A Shop between stages, because a roguelite without a shop is just a difficult puzzle. · A tutorial that leaves quickly and waits in Settings in case you ever want it back. WHAT'S NOT IN IT · Ads. · In-app purchases. · A season pass, a battle pass, or a little bar that refills while you sleep. · An internet connection. This app has never phoned home and wouldn't know who to call. Buy it once and own all of it — every map, every trinket, every Twist. There is nothing else to sell you, and we are not going to think of anything. One deck, thirteen languages. Good luck.

title: Quintra
summary: Quintra brings poker hands to a shared board. Place cards to build pairs, straights, flushes, and more across rows and columns. Connect with cards already in play, find the right opening, and turn one card into points in two directions. ONE BOARD. SO MANY POSSIBILITIES. Build on what's there, line up bonus spaces, and watch for opportunities where hands cross. Your best move could also give your opponent something to work with. PLAY FRIENDS AT YOUR PACE Trade turns through Game Center whenever you're ready. Match Play spans two rounds with the same deal and swapped seats, giving both players a chance to make the most of each hand. A FRESH PUZZLE EVERY DAY Fit the cards to match every marked poker hand. Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard, then see how your completion time stacks up on the daily puzzle leaderboards. EIGHT TURNS. MAKE EACH ONE COUNT. Take on the Daily Challenge: a daily deal, eight solo turns, and a leaderboard to climb. Find the connections that turn a good score into a great one. PLAY SOLO Learn the board in Practice or take on the computer in Match Play. Choose your difficulty and try new approaches at your own pace. MAKE IT YOURS Earn XP, level up, and chase goals and achievements as you play. Unlock new card decks and board looks to make Quintra feel like yours. Every poker hand changes the game.
